headline: Michael Poa Confirms No DepEd Confidential Funds Went to AFP Youth Summits
seoTitle: Poa: No DepEd Secret Funds Went to AFP Youth Summits | FMB News
seoDescription: Former DepEd undersecretary Michael Poa confirmed in the Senate impeachment trial that no DepEd confidential funds were given to the AFP for youth leadership summits.
deck: Poa's testimony reinforced earlier statements from Army officers about the funding of military youth leadership activities.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Former Department of Education Undersecretary Michael Wesley Poa confirmed during Day 21 of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial that no DepEd confidential funds were given to the Armed Forces of the Philippines for the Youth Leadership Summits cited in military certifications.

sections.heading: Why the testimony matters
paragraphs: Poa's answer reinforced earlier testimony from Army officers who said their units did not receive DepEd confidential funds for the activities.

sections.heading: What remains disputed
paragraphs: The impeachment case involves broader questions about how confidential funds were used, documented and defended before state auditors. Poa also testified that he did not have firsthand knowledge of the operational use of the funds.

sections.heading: Legal context
paragraphs: The testimony is evidence in an ongoing impeachment trial and is not a final finding of guilt or liability.
